items.rationale: Insured peril (robbery) and insured property (valuables, timepiece) under 2.3, 4.2.2, 4.2.4. Sub-limit of €2,500 per item and €5,000 per event applies (no schedule). Policy pays replacement value up to sub-limit (6.2.3, 6.3, 7.1.1). Reference cases (45, 31, 57) show t per watch at sub-limit, not actual value. No deductible.

Insured peril (robbery) and insured property (valuables, jewellery) under 2.3, 4.2.2, 4.2.4. Sub-limit of €2,500 per item and €5,000 per event applies (no schedule). Receipt shows higher value, but policy pays up to sub-limit only (6.3, 7.1.1). Reference case 64 (unscheduled jewellery) supports this logic.
Necklace was not taken in the robbery but found missing later, so not an 'affected item' under 2.3.4(a), 7.1.5, 7.1.10. Policy excludes property missing on a separate occasion.

items.description: Compensation for cash taken in robbery
items.rationale: Insured peril (robbery) and insured property (means of payment) under 2.3, 4.2.3, 4.2.4. Sub-limit of €500 per event for cash applies (schedule, 6.3, 7.1.1(c)). Reference cases (45, 57) confirm t at sub-limit.

Insured peril (robbery) and insured property (general household effects, 4.2.1, 4.2.4). No sub-limit for this class, but €10,000 aggregate for property away from home applies (schedule). Market value capped at replacement value for similar model (6.2.1, 7.1.1). Purchase price €700 two years ago; moderate depreciation, but replacement value for similar model likely close to €700. Aggregate event cap not reached.

items.description: Replacement travel and extra hotel nights after the incident
items.rationale: Consequential disruption (travel, accommodation) is expressly excluded (3.1.7, 5.1(e)). Not an insured cost head. Reference cases confirm t = 0 for similar lines.
Ancillary charge for shipping is excluded (7.1.8(b)), not an insured cost head under 5.1. Reference cases: t = 0 in 8 of 9 similar lines under this wording.
Translation of documents for the claim is excluded (3.1.6, 7.1.8(f)). Reference cases: t = 0 in all similar lines.
Certification of documents for the claim is excluded (3.1.6, 7.1.8(f)). Not an insured cost head. Reference cases: t = 0 for all similar lines.
Material costs for claim substantiation are excluded (3.1.6, 7.1.8(e), 7.1.8(f)). Reference cases: t = 0 for all similar lines.
Administrative/claim-processing fees are excluded (3.1.5, 7.1.8(e)). Reference cases: t = 0 for all similar lines.
